purpose: Mark the target of an attitude or set two subjects in contrast.
keywords: Noun + に対して; clause + のに対して
The clerk spoke politely to the customer.
Whereas my older brother is quiet, my younger brother talks a lot.
There was no specific answer to the question.
formation: Noun + に対して; clause + のに対して
restrictions: With a target it means toward; with contrasting clauses it means whereas.
mistake: Use の before に対して when attaching a full verb clause.
